description:
[Calculators] Code lock facts and what makes a door code easy to guess. The facts behind https://rust.wiki/calculators/door-code: the code lock's rules (`facts`: 4 digits, a shock per
wrong guess, 8 wrong tries then a 15-minute lockout, guest codes), the ten most common four-digit codes (cited
from DataGenetics' 2012 PIN study), the `patterns` the page flags as guessable and how long a full brute force
takes. The API deliberately doesn't generate or check codes: the page makes them in your own browser and never
sends them anywhere - open the page for a code. For a random code use generate_door_code; to rate a code use check_door_code.
name: get_door_code_rules
title: Code lock facts and what makes a door code easy to guess
